exposure: Equilibration time (8-11 minutes vs. 12-15 minutes) during blastocyst vitrification
cohort: 192 blastocysts (80 non-expanded and 112 expanded) obtained from 167 patients.
finding: For expanded blastocysts, a longer equilibration time (12-15 minutes) was associated with improved survival, implantation, and live birth rates, while for non-expanded blastocysts, a shorter equilibration time (8-11 minutes) was sufficient.
